title: Intersection Cardinality as a Pair Count
statement: For subsets $U,J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the square of the size of their intersection equals the number of ordered pairs $(i,j)\in U\times U$ for which both $i$ and $j$ belong to $J$: $|U\cap J|^2=\sum_{i\in U}\sum_{j\in U}\mathbf{1}_{i\in J\,\wedge\,j\in J}$.
